chunks: He said: Ali ibn Maaz narrated: I said to Safwan ibn Yahya

Through which reasoning have you adopted faith in the Imamate of Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s)? He replied: I prayed the ritual prayer and after that sought counsel (Istikhara) from Almighty Allah and the result was that I got certainty about it.

key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Referring to Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s), the seventh Imam
key_terms.قَطَعْتَ: To cut off/determine, here meaning to reach certainty or conviction

ai.seo_question: How did Safwan ibn Yahya attain certainty in the Imamate of Imam Musa al-Kadhim?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the practical methodology of the *Waqifiya* and early Shia scholars in verifying the Imamate of Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) through spiritual introspection rather than mere intellectual argument. Safwan ibn Yahya’s reliance on *Salat* (prayer), *Du'a* (supplication), and *Istikhara* (seeking divine guidance) underscores the Shia emphasis on combining rational inquiry with spiritual certainty (*yaqin*) to overcome doubts about the hidden Imam.
